claims.evidence: Witness report describes a light grey/cream insulated bag with embossed logo/text reading/appearing as “BENNY'SCHOOL”; no clear “HP Power” text or model is shown in the report.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (witness sees “BENNY'SCHOOL” while seller claims “HP Power”), which affects resale value and buyer confidence.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the exact printed/embossed brand name and any product label/variant tag on the bag (front logo and inside tag).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used insulated lunch bag with uncertain brand/variant.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or poor insulation not visible (interior lining condition, stains/odors, and whether insulation is intact).
risks.proof: A photo of the interior lining (fully opened) plus a close-up of any seams and the bottom panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used and possibly not fully clean/odor-free; assume worst-case interior condition.

risks.risk: Zipper and compartments may be faulty (smoothness, missing pulls, broken sliders) though the bag looks intact.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the zipper opening/closing smoothly and the small side compartment opening/closing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as “may have zipper issues” until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/attachments (changing mat, extra compartments, straps) or non-functional handle/strap.
risks.proof: Photos showing all included parts laid out (handle/strap, any attachments) and a clip lifting the bag by the handle to confirm sturdiness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as only the bag itself, with no guaranteed accessories.

risks.risk: Capacity/dimensions unknown; affects suitability and price.
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape (length/width/height) and/or a hand-size reference, plus what fits inside (e.g., lunch box size).
risks.if_unproven: Price based on typical small lunch-bag capacity (worst-case for value).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the exact front logo/text and any inside brand/variant label (to confirm whether it is “HP Power” or “BENNY'SCHOOL”).
Show the interior lining fully opened (no stains/tears/odor) with close-ups of seams and the bottom.
Provide a short video of the main zipper and side compartment zipper opening and closing smoothly.
Confirm included items: any straps/attachments and whether any accessories (e.g., changing mat) are present; show them laid out.
Share exact dimensions (length/width/height) and approximate capacity (what lunch box sizes fit).
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies it as an insulated lunch bag in used but intact condition, so it can be priced at a worst-case generic used level. The seller’s “HP Power” claim is not verifiable from the report, so pricing should assume uncertain brand/variant and possible hidden issues until the requested proof is provided.
